title: The Role of Big Data Analytics in Strengthening Cyber Defense Mechanisms for Autonomous Vehicles
content: The integration of autonomous vehicles (AVs) into modern transportation systems brings numerous benefits, including enhanced safety, efficiency, and convenience. However, their reliance on advanced software, interconnected systems, and real-time data processing exposes them to significant cybersecurity threats. Big Data Analytics (BDA) emerges as a critical tool in fortifying the cyber defense mechanisms of AVs, offering capabilities for real-time threat detection, predictive analysis, and system resilience. This article explores the intersection of BDA and AV cybersecurity, highlighting its role in identifying vulnerabilities, mitigating risks, and enabling adaptive responses to evolving cyber threats. It delves into practical applications such as anomaly detection, automated diagnostics, and predictive maintenance, while addressing challenges like data privacy and integration complexities. By examining case studies and future trends, this study underscores the necessity for a collaborative approach among industry stakeholders to harness BDA's full potential in safeguarding autonomous vehicles. The findings advocate for a proactive adoption of BDA-driven solutions as an essential pillar of AV cybersecurity.
